_comments: Must push before metadata/queries. 'queries' sorts before 'query-categories' alphabetically;
directoryOrder in metadata/.mj-sync.json puts this folder first.

fields.Name: Common
fields.Description: BizApps Common directory read models. Dashboard tiles COUNT the whole party file — they must not be derived from a MaxRows-capped RunView.

_comments: The Party Signals registry. Each app ships ONE query here answering 'which organizations and
people are our customers, and how recently' for its own records. The party pickers and the
Get Party Signals action discover queries by this category, so Common never imports an app.
Contract: PartyKind ('organization'|'person'), PartyID, Count, LastActivityAt, and a
[signal: noun|nouns] marker in the query Description for the picker's chip text.

fields.Name: Party Signals
fields.Description: Per-app answers to 'which organizations and people are our customers, and how recently'. Contract: PartyKind ('organization'|'person'), PartyID, Count, LastActivityAt; the Description carries [signal: noun|nouns].
